title: Tall whites posing as Charlie Hall and his wife to visit Livermore

tellings.quote: named Charlie Hall. and she would specifically pretend to be his wife so they could go into places like Liverour and pretend to be humans and talk to the the scientists.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall, pale, human-like aliens he calls the tall whites, says that in the 1960s some of them passed as humans to visit Lawrence Livermore Laboratory, a US government weapons research lab in California. According to Hall, one went by the name Charlie Hall, and a female tall white named Pamela pretended to be his wife so they could go in and talk to the scientists. If true, it would mean aliens were quietly mixing with top American scientists.
